This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This humanoid sentient species was distinguished by their [[Color|orange]] skin and a pair of stubby [[eye]]stalks.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Unidentified-Eyestalk-Borgo.png|thumb|left|250px|A member of this species walks past Wim and Neel at Port Borgo]]
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]], a member of this species could be found on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], seen departing from a [[Unidentified two-engined passenger transport|passenger transport]] parked at the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] and passing by the [[Exile (punishment)|exiled]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who intended to board the same shuttle on a mission to save a young [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]].<ref name="Kenobi I">{{Kenobi|Part I}}</ref>

Shortly thereafter,<ref name="Kenobi Date II">{{KenobiDate|II}}</ref> another member of this species could be found on the planet [[Daiyu]] when Obi-Wan and Leia arrived.<ref name="Kenobi II">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref> At least two members could be found on [[Coruscant]] at some point<ref name="Convert">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 19: The Convert}}
</ref> during [[9 ABY]].<ref name="M19Date">{{MandoDate|19}}</ref>Yet another member of this species walks intimidatingly past young castaways [[Wim]], [[Neel]], [[Fern]], and [[KB]] when they first arrive at [[Borgo Prime|Port Borgo]],<ref name="Skeleton Crew">{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}}</ref> while a fourth member of this species was present at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in [[Canto Bight]] on [[Cantonica]] when the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] arrived searching for the [[Master Codebreaker]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[2017]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi]]'', directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" />
